title: AI from Zero
description: Start from nothing and build a clear, practical understanding of AI: what it is, how language models work, and how to run one yourself.

levels.description: What AI is, how it works under the hood, and how to get set up. No experience needed.
The key ideas behind modern AI: training, prompts, context and how models are measured.
Use AI tools for real tasks, run models on your own computer and compare the results.
Put it together: small projects that use AI to solve problems you care about.
